STATUS: fail SUMMARY: Two reproduced [blocking] bugs, both in nested Dialogs: one Escape closes the outer dialog too, and Tab inside the inner dialog is pulled back out to the outer one. Most other probes passed: Combobox inside Dialog and inside a form, Tabs id uniqueness and special values, display:none focus handling, open/close focus return, disabled and removed selected tabs, and options changing while open. Probe files are deleted and `git status` matches the start. FILES TOUCHED: none (probes `src/__probe__.test.tsx` and `src/__probe2__.test.tsx` created and deleted) FINDINGS: - [blocking] Nested Dialog: one Escape closes the outer dialog as well as the inner one. Each Dialog registers its own document keydown listener with no top-layer check. Repro: outer open, inner opened from a button inside outer, `userEvent.keyboard("{Escape}")` → inner called once, outer called with `false` (`expected "spy" to be called +0 times, but got 1 times`). - [blocking] Nested Dialog: Tab trap fights itself. The outer `trapTab` sees focus inside the inner portal (outside its container) and pulls focus to its own first button. Repro: inner buttons i1, i2; `Tab` from i1 lands on the outer button, not i2 (`src/__probe2__.test.tsx:38` failed, received focus on outer button). - [minor] Dialog backdrop closes on any `click` without a `mousedown` on the backdrop (`onClick` only). Not reproduced in a drag test; it only shows up with programmatic clicks. - [minor] `description=""` still renders an empty `

` and sets `aria-describedby` to it. Not reproduced by a probe; read from the code. CHECKS: - Nested Dialog Escape (one Escape, inner open) → FAIL (outer closed too). - Nested Dialog Tab trap (i1 → i2) → FAIL. - Combobox in Dialog: Escape with listbox open closes only the listbox → PASS. - Combobox in form: Enter with open listbox does not submit → PASS. - Combobox in form: Enter when closed submits natively → PASS. - Two Tabs with identical values get distinct ids and aria-controls resolves → PASS. - Tabs values `"a b"`, `"a_b"`, `"a:b"`, `""`, `"é"`, `"a-b"`, `"_95_"`, `"a.b"`, `'x"y'`: ids unique, aria-controls resolves, aria-labelledby matches → PASS. - Dialog initial focus skips display:none focusables → PASS. - Dialog Tab trap skips hidden focusables → PASS. - Dialog open→close→open ×3 returns focus to opener each time → PASS. - Dialog drag from inside to backdrop does not close → PASS. - Tabs selected becomes disabled → selection falls back, one aria-selected, one tabIndex=0 → PASS. - Tabs selected removed (uncontrolled) → single tabbable tab, aria-selected on the fallback → PASS. - Tabs keyboard: ArrowLeft wraps to last, skips disabled, Home/End, and onValueChange fires → PASS. - Tabs: Tab from selected tab reaches the selected panel → PASS. - Combobox: options prepended while open keep the same active item; Enter commits it → PASS. - Combobox: active item removed by options change clears aria-activedescendant and Enter does nothing → PASS. - Combobox: controlled parent ignores onChange; blur and close show the parent's label → PASS. - Combobox: regex chars literal, whitespace trimmed, unmatched value → empty input, "No results" shown, no activedescendant → PASS. - Combobox: Escape restores the label, no onChange → PASS. - Combobox: mousedown commits enabled option; disabled click is a no-op → PASS. - Combobox: all options disabled → no active option, Enter does nothing → PASS. - Dialog: Escape from a nested input closes; Shift+Tab/Tab trap wraps → PASS. - Dialog: opener removed before close → no throw, dialog closes → PASS. - Combobox with duplicate option values → renders without error (no key-collision assertion made) → PASS. OPEN QUESTIONS: Nested dialogs aren't in the written criteria, but the triggered checks call for them. Decide whether the fix is in scope for this change, or whether nested dialogs should be documented as unsupported in the README.
